questions.prompt: Which of these were civilisations of the Americas?
questions.fact: The Inca ran an empire of ten million people across the Andes without money, wheels or a written alphabet.

questions.prompt: Which of these animals are reptiles?
questions.fact: Frogs, salamanders and toads are amphibians: they breathe through wet skin and most of them start life in water.

questions.prompt: Roughly how many hairs are on a person's head?
questions.fact: About 100,000, and you lose 50 to 100 of them every day.

questions.prompt: How many teaspoons of sugar are in a can of cola?
questions.fact: About nine. You cannot taste how sweet it is because the acid in it hides the sugar.

questions.prompt: Which is the only mammal that can truly fly?
questions.fact: Bats make up about a fifth of all mammal species.

questions.prompt: Which letter does not appear in the name of any US state?
questions.hint: Arizona has one of the other three, Texas another, New Jersey the last.
questions.fact: Q is the only one. Z is in Arizona, X in Texas and J in New Jersey.
